technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value:
The manufacturing begins with the preparation of plastisol containing PVC, plasticizer and additives. Plastisol is used as the first coating on the base polyester fabric. Dry blend containing PVC, plasticizer and additives is prepared, melted, extruded and hot pressed into sheet, which is then calendered on the fabric. The fabric is calendered twice, once on both sides. About 12 % of raw material mass ends up as manufacturing rejects. PVC and plasticizer rejects are used in other products (10 %), while fabric rejects are landfilled (2 %). The sales, marketing and production of this product have been certified according to the following standard: ISO 9001 
Technical data: 
Performance data of the product with respect to its characteristics in accordance with the relevant technical provision (no CE-marking). 
Declared unit: 
The declared unit for Vinyplan 6319 is 1 m2 of fabric. The conversion factor to mass per declared unit is 0.7 kg/m2.

Die Herstellung beginnt mit der Zubereitung von Plastisol, das PVC, Weichmacher und Additive enthält. Plastisol wird als erste Beschichtung auf dem Polyestergrundgewebe verwendet. Die Trockenmischung, die PVC, Weichmacher und Additive enthält, wird vorbereitet, geschmolzen, extrudiert und heiß zu einer Folie gepresst, die dann auf das Gewebe kalandriert wird. Das Gewebe wird zweimal kalandriert, einmal auf beiden Seiten.

Etwa 12 % der Rohmaterialmasse fallen als Produktionsabfälle an. PVC- und Weichmacherabfälle werden in anderen Produkten verwendet (10 %), während Gewebeabfälle deponiert werden (2 %).  


Der Vertrieb, das Marketing und die Produktion dieses Produkts wurden nach der folgenden Norm zertifiziert: 


ISO 9001

technologicalApplicability.value: The range of applications for 6319 is fabric material mainly for storage curtains, partition curtains, temporary silo and protective covers.
6319 wird hauptsächlich für Lagervorhänge, Trennvorhänge, temporäre Silo- und Schutzabdeckungen verwendet.

Scope: 
This EPD describes Vinyplan 6319, a technical fabric manufactured by Oy Scantarp Ab in Kuopio, Finland.

The declared product is a fully airtight polyethylene terephthalate - polyvinyl chloride (PET-PVC) based technical textile. The base fabric is composed of high tenacity, low shrinkage, multifilament polyester yarns.



EPD type is cradle-to-gate with modules C1-C4 and D. The EPD is created based on the background report including a study compiled for this product. 
System boundary: 
The type of the EPD is cradle to gate with options: including modules A1-A3, C1-C4 and D. The declared life cycle stages and accompanying processes are listed below: 


A1-A3:

A1: Production of raw materials.
A2: Transport of raw materials and packaging materials to the manufacturer.
A3: Production of packaging materials, fuels, energy and water.
A3: Manufacturing process and emissions from fuels, energy and processing.
A3: Transport and treatment of wastes.

C1-C4:

C1: Deconstruction of the product from building.
C2: Transport of used product to end-of-life treatment.
C4/1: Incineration with energy recovery.
C4/2 (alternative scenario): Landfill disposal.


D:

Credits acquired from material and energy recovery across the product system.
